bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; cats=$(q "SELECT count(DISTINCT p.message_thread_id) FROM posting_topics p JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins d ON d.chat_id=p.chat_id AND d.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id WHERE p.chat_id=-1003770334893 AND p.board_key='gay_board' AND p.purpose='announcement' AND p.enabled=TRUE AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.verified_by IS NOT NULL AND d.state='published' AND d.pinned=TRUE AND d.message_id>0") || exit 81; video=$(q "SELECT count(DISTINCT p.message_thread_id) FROM posting_topics p JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins d ON d.chat_id=p.chat_id AND d.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id WHERE p.chat_id=-1002373696859 AND p.board_key='video_chat' AND p.purpose='announcement' AND p.enabled=TRUE AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.verified_by IS NOT NULL AND d.state='published' AND d.pinned=TRUE AND d.message_id>0") || exit 82; test "$cats" -le 15 && test "$video" -le 15 || exit 83; exit $((100+16*cats+video))
